overall_goal: Hard-boil an egg in a saucepan

goals.description: Place the egg in the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person prepares the saucepan and places the egg inside after retrieving it from the fridge.
The person carries the saucepan to the sink and fills it with tap water.

goals.description: Heat the saucepan on the hob
goals.rationale: The person places the water-filled saucepan on the hob and turns it on to boil the egg.
